plugins.name: prep-report
plugins.description: Convert analysis session artifacts into a structured report — slides, doc, or Anthropic Science blog-style write-up (interactive interview + outline approval gate)

plugins.name: generate-slides
plugins.description: Generate PPTX slide decks from session artifacts with interactive outline brainstorming and programmatic generation via python-pptx

plugins.name: figure-style
plugins.description: Enforce publication-quality figure styling with automated verification — font sizes, colors, labels, layout, and export settings

plugins.name: meeting-distill
plugins.description: Distill a Zoom (or generic) meeting note into TL;DR + action items by owner + chronological timeline

plugins.name: codeql-quality-review
plugins.description: Audit and fix GitHub Code Quality findings (/security/quality) through the REST API with gh api. A SARIF workflow is the fallback for findings the API does not return

plugins.name: agent-board
plugins.description: Live kanban board over parallel Claude Code agents working in git worktrees

plugins.name: email-report
plugins.description: Email a threaded status/report from a long-running or unattended session via a local MTA — no OAuth, no API key

plugins.name: build-kg
plugins.description: Build an interactive knowledge graph from a folder of markdown documentation files. Extracts wikilinks, standard links, tags, and headings to generate an HTML graph visualization and summary index.

plugins.name: overleaf-manuscript
plugins.description: Sync-mode detection, a prose audit and an ask-before-edit hook for LaTeX manuscripts that sync with Overleaf
